prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady ascent along a rugged, rocky trail on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera moves forward, capturing the uneven terrain covered with patches of snow and sparse vegetation. As the path progresses, the view opens up to reveal a breathtaking panorama of snow-capped mountains shrouded in mist, with the sun casting a soft, diffused light over the landscape. The camera continues to advance, following a narrow, snow-lined path bordered by a metal railing on one side, providing a sense of safety against the steep drop-offs. The surrounding environment is serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence except for the trail itself. The camera angle shifts slightly as the path curves, offering different perspectives of the towering peaks and the dense fog that blankets the lower valleys. As the journey continues, the mist thickens, reducing visibility and creating an ethereal atmosphere. The camera moves steadily through this foggy section, the railing guiding the way as the trail becomes increasingly obscured by the dense white clouds, enveloping the scene in a tranquil, almost otherworldly silence.
